0.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_TRANSFORMHLW2018_000_000
0.description: A minion of the Continental Circus? Me? Never! I am but a fun-loving imp, here to help my fellow revelers enjoy the Wake. Ehehehe... In fact, I can offer you a <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> convincing guise for the masquerade. And it won't cost a single gil!
0.translation_description: Un tirapiedi del Circo Continentale? Io? Mai! Sono solo un diavoletto burlone, qui per aiutare gli altri festaioli a godersi la Veglia. Ehehehe... Posso persino offrirti un travestimento <hex:021A020203>davvero<hex:021A020103> convincente per il ballo in maschera. E non ti costerà neanche un gil!

1.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_TRANSFORMHLW2018_100_001
1.description: All I need is your memory of someone, someone who made a <hex:021A020203>strong<hex:021A020103> impression. Someone unforgettable, someone <hex:021A020203>powerful<hex:021A020103>. Yes, that's it...
1.translation_description: Mi basta che tu ricordi qualcuno, qualcuno che ti abbia lasciato un’impressione <hex:021A020203>forte<hex:021A020103>. Qualcuno di indimenticabile, qualcuno di <hex:021A020203>potente<hex:021A020103>. Sì, proprio così...

2.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_TRANSFORMHLW2018_000_001
2.description: All I need is for you to recall a journey, a journey unforgettable. Traverse your memories, and tell me what you see...
2.translation_description: Mi basta che tu ricordi un viaggio, un viaggio indimenticabile. Ripercorri i tuoi ricordi e raccontami che cosa vedi...

4.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A1_000_001
4.description: A journey to forge this realm anew.
4.translation_description: Un viaggio per forgiare di nuovo questo mondo.

5.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A1_000_002
5.description: A journey to end a conflict of one thousand years.
5.translation_description: Un viaggio per porre fine a un conflitto durato mille anni.

6.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A1_000_003
6.description: A journey to liberate lands near and far.
6.translation_description: Un viaggio per liberare terre vicine e lontane.

7.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_TRANSFORMHLW2018_000_003
7.description: Good, good. Now think of someone remarkable you encountered in that time, someone <hex:021A020203>powerful<hex:021A020103>. Yes, that's it...
7.translation_description: Bene, bene. Ora pensa a qualcuno di straordinario che hai incontrato in quel periodo, qualcuno di <hex:021A020203>potente<hex:021A020103>. Sì, proprio così...

9.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A2_000_001
9.description: A charming and compassionate Lalafellin lady of noble birth.
9.translation_description: Una gentildonna Lalafell affascinante e compassionevole, di nobili natali.

10.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A2_000_002
10.description: A Padjali woman as gentle yet indomitable as nature itself.
10.translation_description: Una donna Padjal, gentile ma indomita quanto la natura stessa.

11.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A2_000_003
11.description: A stalwart Roegadyn woman of unshakable conviction.
11.translation_description: Una salda donna Roegadyn, dalla convinzione incrollabile.

12.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A2_000_004
12.description: A rugged Hyuran man unmatched in loyalty and valor.
12.translation_description: Un vigoroso uomo Hyur, senza pari per lealtà e valore.

13.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A2_000_005
13.description: A blue-eyed Elezen man with a heart noble and true.
13.translation_description: Un Elezen dagli occhi azzurri, dal cuore nobile e sincero.

14.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A2_000_006
14.description: A robed Lalafellin woman of the intellectual persuasion.
14.translation_description: Una Lalafell in tunica, dalle spiccate inclinazioni intellettuali.

15.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A2_000_007
15.description: A dauntless Hyuran man of integrity from the Far East.
15.translation_description: Un impavido e integerrimo Hyur dell'Estremo Oriente.

16.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A2_000_008
16.description: A devoted Auri woman who has mastered the art of the shinobi.
16.translation_description: Una devota donna Au Ra, maestra nell'arte degli shinobi.

17.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A2_000_009
17.description: An Auri woman strong of body and stronger of will.
17.translation_description: Una donna Au Ra forte nel corpo e ancor più nella volontà.

18.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A2_000_010
18.description: A haughty but valorous Auri man with a yearning heart.
18.translation_description: Un guerriero Au Ra altero ma valoroso, dal cuore che anela all'amore.

19.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A2_000_011
19.description: A sweet Auri woman who lives according to her faith.
19.translation_description: Una dolce donna Au Ra, che vive secondo la propria fede.

20.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_A2_000_012
20.description: A crimson-garbed Hyuran woman fleet of foot and fist.
20.translation_description: Una donna Hyur vestita di rosso, agile nel passo e fulminea nei pugni.

22.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_TRANSFORMHLW2018_000_010
22.description: Ehehehe... That will do nicely. Don't worry, this won't hurt much at all! Just close your eyes...
22.translation_description: Ehehehe... Sarà perfetto. Non preoccuparti, non farà quasi per niente male! Chiudi gli occhi...

24.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_SYSTEM_000_013
24.description: Use the special action Unveil to remove the effects of transfiguration and return to your usual form.
24.translation_description: Usa l’azione speciale «Rivela» per annullare la trasformazione e tornare alla tua forma abituale.

25.name: TEXT_FESANV2018TRANSFORM_00535_TRANSFORMHLW2018_000_020
25.description: Pay no mind to the little imp in the corner. Ehehehe...
25.translation_description: Non badare al diavoletto in quell’angolo. Ehehehe...
